description: Historical Reddit COMMENTS via the Arctic Shift archive — scope to a subreddit, a specific post (link_id), or both; requires at least one. Optionally filter by keyword (query, matched against comment body) and date range (after/before, ISO dates). Returns id, author, created_utc (ISO), score, body, link_id, permalink. No per-author aggregation is provided by this pack — results are the raw comments Arctic Shift's filters match, nothing rolled up into a user profile.

after.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2019-01-01") — only comments created on/after this date.

before.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2020-01-01") — only comments created before this date.

link_id.description: Reddit post ID to fetch comments under, e.g. "ei9204" (with or without the "t3_" prefix). Provide this and/or subreddit.

query.description: Optional keyword — matched against comment body text.

sort.description: "asc" or "desc" by comment date (default "desc", newest first).

subreddit.description: Subreddit name without the r/ prefix, e.g. "datasets". Provide this and/or link_id.

name: reddit_history_comments
title: Reddit History Comments
